title: Northwest Micro Systems
description: nwmicro.com Northwest Micro Systems, formally Northwest Micro Inc., is a private IT services and software company founded in 1998 in Atlanta, Georgia, serving small businesses with managed IT, cloud backup, email, CRM and custom .NET development. Led by founder and owner Leo Zhadanovsky, it has around 11 employees and steady revenue of roughly 5 million dollars. Its unique model offers affordable one-time products like the One 2 One email server and Speed To Success CRM for about 100 dollars with lifetime updates and support. The company positions itself as the anti-corporate alternative to Oracle and Microsoft, focused on keeping small business clients for life. Core strengths are 28 years of market presence, a loyal SMB client base and a low-overhead operation. Its tech stack centers on Microsoft 365, SQL Server and .NET with a mix of SaaS and on-premise tools.
